question: What is the size of the European legal tech market and how fast is it growing?
title: European Legal Tech Market Size and Growth Projections

sentences.text: According to a single source, the European legal technology market is projected to reach USD 9.02 billion in 2026.
The market is projected to grow at a compound annual growth rate of 10.78% between 2026 and 2034, while a separate single source projects a 9.60% CAGR over the 2026-2035 period.
Adoption of legal tech solutions is heavily propelled by regulatory compliance demands, including GDPR, the AI Act, AML, and sustainable finance disclosures.
